comment: One layer-2 segment carved into a /24 per class of device. Each zone has its own gateway and hands out a /24 mask, so traffic between zones is routed through the firewall and can actually be filtered. With a single wide mask every block is on-link to every other and firewall rules load but match nothing.

zones.name: Personal
zones.description: Laptops, phones, tablets and watches belonging to people in the house.

zones.name: Infrastructure
zones.description: The firewall, hypervisors, containers, resolvers and build runners.

zones.name: IoT
zones.description: Smart plugs, bulbs, speakers, thermostats, cameras and other appliances.

zones.name: Media and Consoles
zones.description: Consoles, headsets, TVs and streaming devices.

zones.name: Unidentified
zones.description: Devices Flowsight could not identify. No internet; HTTP is answered by the identification page. Kept clear of the host's own untagged pool lower in the same block, so the two do not define overlapping ranges with different lease times.

always_allow.comment: Reachable from every zone regardless of reach_zones, because removing these breaks the network rather than segmenting it: the gateway itself, and name resolution.
